question:
Analyze the five Problem Figures (A, B, C, D, E) to determine the established sequential pattern. Select the next figure in the series

from the five Answer Figures (1, 2, 3, 4, 5).

Problem Figure: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdb8990c0fa1eaa8cc16935f55387c9e3ec2b74cd6f2d8ccfad2af14c0190e42.png] 

Answer Figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7e156b6b5ac17941e0c86fd4d3a83588413177c156f9ccdd188f2ba22e801e4.png]
solution:
**1. Tracking the Central Shape**

The central shape is essentially a diagonal line connecting two horizontal lines (forming a "Z" or "N" shape). In each step, the entire figure rotates **90° clockwise**.

 
• 
 
**A to B:** Rotates 90° clockwise (The top horizontal line moves to the right side).

 
 
• 
 
**B to C:** Rotates 90° clockwise (The right side moves to the bottom).

 
 
• 
 
**C to D:** Rotates 90° clockwise (The bottom moves to the left side).

 
 
• 
 
**D to E:** Rotates 90° clockwise (The left side moves to the top).

 
 
•
